newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open flat ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open flat ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Singapore's key share index opened almost unchanged on Tuesday ahead of a meeting of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee, widely expected to raise a key interest rate by 25 basis points.
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials index (STII) was down 0.48 at 2,156.31 points by 0105 GMT with Fraser & Neave (F&N) and Cycle & Carriage (C&C) again leading the losers board.
Both firms were down 10 cents with F&N at Singapore $14.50 (US$10.28) and C&C at S$15.00.
Dealers said part of the current weakness of the index was due to poor Singapore export figures on Friday.
Friday's data showed a 6.3 percent year-on-year drop in Singapore non-oil exports thanks to a fall in electronics sales.
But dealers said the market was also extremely worried over the impact of the possible rise in U.S. interest rates at the FOMC meeting. The FOMC is due to meet later on Tuesday.
